exposure: Implementation of an evidence-based standardized care pathway for induction of labor
cohort: 1471 women who underwent induction of labor, with 392 inductions before and 1079 inductions after the implementation of a standardized care pathway
finding: The introduction of a standardized induction of labor pathway was associated with a nonsignificant reduction in time from admission to delivery and improved pregnancy outcomes, including decreased infections and unanticipated outcomes.
mod_finding: There was a significant decrease in the time to delivery by 1.7 hours for vaginal deliveries after protocol implementation (P=.02).
